# Dobb

An old Shrewish who has run the rafts out of Brackenmouth's river door for thirty years. He counts out loud, always: rafts, heads, oars. He is careful and kind and loads every raft too full because he cannot bear to make anyone wait.

He has never told anyone he cannot swim. When a raft tips, he freezes. Play him steady right up until the moment he isn't.
